name: web-early-access-login-card-on-big-screen
title: Early-access sign-up page on a wall screen in a glossy dark gallery
whatItIs: A full-size view of the wall screen with a NeuralFlow logo, a serif 'Get Early Access', desert mountains and a floating white login form, standing on a black plinth over a reflective dark floor with blue-grey walls.
whatItMeans: Cinematic and calm; the dark reflective gallery makes a simple page feel valuable.
techniques: Set the screen on a black plinth.
Keep the page mostly white with one photo.

vocabulary.definition: A glossy surface mirroring the scene.
